mosaic_section.subject: Eighty-one Cent fronts, 9 across and 9 down, each coin cut out onto the stage colour (#0b0a0a).
mosaic_section.source: cents.gallery media library C001 'Ten-thousand-cent obverse mosaic' (c001-ten-thousand-cent-obverse-mosaic.jpg, 26000 x 26000). Columns 45-53, rows 45-53 of its 259.2 px grid, cut at full resolution and halved; each coin's box measured (122-125 px at half size) and masked to a circle, as pipeline/stage_cents.py does for the 300 px images. No coin is retouched. The library file is truncated: it ends on an RST marker (ff d3), not EOI (ff d9), and its last 26 of 3250 rows at 1/8 scale decode as flat grey, so the whole mosaic is not shown.

atlas_assassin.subject: The Traits Atlas entry for Assassin on cents.vision: the heading 'Assassin (Motif)' and the summary 'Prominent spherical obsidian, verdigris or contamination striking Abe’s head, neck, or torso – the mark of an imagined projectile.', marked by a translucent copper highlight added by us.
atlas_assassin.source: Screenshot of https://cents.vision/traits-atlas/assassin.html at a 240 px viewport, 3x, taken 2026-11-21 with Playwright (script/atlas_shoot.cjs, from #8820's); highlight drawn from the sentence's measured client rects; cropped to whole lines.
